semantic.text: [FR-01-001] MB/NC FR | type te | 6.2/Figure 1 | sheet: The caption should name the head material of the mallet. Proposed change: Mallet with felt head
[FR-01-002] MB/NC FR | type ed | 5.1.1/para 1 | sheet: Use the verb hold rather than grip. Proposed change: The clamp shall hold the handle with a soft lining.
[FR-01-003] MB/NC FR | type ge | 7 | sheet: The test report clause could point to a reporting template. Proposed change: Add a reference to a reporting template.
[FR-01-004] MB/NC FR | type te | 6.1/para 1 | sheet: Seven days of conditioning is too short for dense timber. Proposed change: for fourteen days before the test

[GB-01-001] MB/NC GB | type te | 1/para 2 | sheet: The lower pitch limit is too low; forks below 250 Hz behave differently. Proposed change: It applies to forks with a nominal pitch between 250 Hz and 900 Hz.

[GB-01-002] MB/NC GB | type ed | 3.2 | sheet: The definition should not start with the word change, which reads like an instruction. Proposed change: variation in the fundamental frequency of a fork over a stated conditioning period
[GB-01-003] MB/NC GB | type te | 5.1/Table 1 | sheet: A clamp height of 80 mm is too low for long forks. Proposed change: 120 mm
[GB-01-004] MB/NC GB | type ge | 4/Note 2 | sheet: Consider deleting this note; it adds nothing. Proposed change: Delete Note 2.

[GB-02-001] MB/NC GB | type te | 5 | sheet: A clause on safety is missing; insert a new clause titled Safety before the Apparatus clause. Proposed change: Wear hearing protection when striking forks repeatedly.
[GB-02-002] MB/NC GB | type ed | A.1/Table A.1 | sheet: The caption should say what the results are. Proposed change: Example drift results
[PR-DE-01-001] MB/NC DE | type te | 5.1.1/para 1 | pr: Say what the soft lining is made of. Proposed change: The clamp shall hold the handle with a soft lining. The lining shall be felt.
[PR-US-01-001] MB/NC US | type ed | 5.1.1/para 1 | pr: These two sentences about the lining should use the same voice. Proposed change: Replace the lining as soon as it shows wear.
[PR-US-01-002] MB/NC US | type ge | 5.1.1 | pr: Consider merging this subclause into its parent clause. Proposed change: Merge the clamp subclause into the test stand subclause.
